steps.text: Two weeks later...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hey, Teacher's Pet? We've been waiting here for nearly a whole day already.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You saw the news that the Messenger brought us from HQ, didn't you?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: They said the ETA is tomorrow afternoon.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And also that we needed to spend the day before preparing everything needed for the connection.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The Davistown connectors were working fine to start with. Laura got it all up and running in half a day, and now we're just standing around with our thumbs up our butts.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If you're cold, you're free to use the tent we set up, or warm yourself by the fire.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What if I'm not cold... what if I'm afraid?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Of what?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I don't know. I just... really can't tell how this whole thing will go down.
Liskarm brings her communicator to her ear, looking slightly impatient.
It's not receiving any signal. This proves that Fort Barron, known to Blacksteel's operators as 'the landship,' has yet to enter transmission range.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Not going to warm yourself up a little longer, Jessica?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'll pass... It's almost dark. I'll feel cold regardless.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: You shouldn't worry too much. I mean, yeah, I'm real mad about the bank too, but the landship is almost here.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: The boss isn't about to let those banker bastards make a fool of us.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Boss? Which boss?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Mr. Cliff, of course! Who else?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: He...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It's hard to say. I mean... in the end, he's a businessman.
Jessica silently looks in the direction of the platform. Instinctively, she reaches into her pouch and rubs the bullet inside.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Look over there... Is that a fire...?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Where?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Right on the plate, close to the mining district... Maybe they started a fire by accident while heating themselves up—

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Hold on, no, there's not just one... Wh-What is this...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Jessica?!

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: ...team, Blacksteel... ship estimated to... arrive in...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Acknowledged.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Jessica, let everybody know—

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Captain, there are multiple distinct fires on the plate! I don't know what's going on, but I have to go check!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Why now of all times... But we've already got the signal from the landship. Fort Barron shouldn't be far—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Jessica—Jessica! Where are you going?! Captain, what do we do?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Let her go. We'll continue the connection mission.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: ...What's with all the ruckus at this hour?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Where's that noise coming from...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Someone's pounding the plant?!
Woodrow grabs his firearm from under his pillow and listens closely to the commotion downstairs.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Hurry up and get down here, Woody! Someone broke in!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Bleuch... Feels awful.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: If I'd known... I wouldn't have drank so much.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I'm so tired. Maybe I'll just lie down here... That way, I'll freeze to death on the street by tomorrow for sure...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What's that noise? What's going on?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: What the hell is this?!

steps.name: Blacksteel Engineering Team Member
steps.text: R-Run... These people just... barged in... and started smashing and looting...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Who are they?

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: Huh... So it's you, gramps.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: You're the one from the snowfield...

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: I'm a pretty lucky guy, gramps. Shh, don't make a fuss. You'll attract others.

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: You were real lucky too, getting away from me, but I wonder how long that luck will last.

steps.name: Blacksteel Engineering Team Member
steps.text: Run! You can't take him on!

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: So you're here too, old timer. Good, saves us the trouble of looking for you.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What's going on, Helena? I figured you'd have knocked them all out by the time I got downstairs.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: ...They've gotten a lot more reckless. They've really gone nuts.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Hey now, no whispering. If you've got something nice to say, you can share it with the class.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You ignorant brat...

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Those bullets must be real pricy, yeah? So expensive... you don't even have all six rounds loaded.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What are you getting at?

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Makes sense. There ain't a whole lot of materials you can use on this plate.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: I mean, if it weren't for that, how come you've been packing that piece every day for all these years, and I ain't never heard about nobody getting shot?

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: My friends, these two bastards are well past their expiration date. Put 'em out of their misery, then help yourselves to whatever you find.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What... What are you people doing?!

steps.name: Troublemaking Thug
steps.text: Out of the way, boozehound.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Wh-Who gave you the right to... to make trouble here... Ugh...

steps.name: Troublemaking Thug
steps.text: Here, lemme treat you to another bottle. Now get some sleep.

steps.name: Rabble-rousing Ruffian
steps.text: Heh, nice one. Died as he lived, with a drink in his face.

steps.name: Troublemaking Thug
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Rabble-rousing Ruffian
steps.text: That's about everything there is to grab. Head to the next shop?

steps.name: Panic-stricken Shop Proprietor
steps.text: Are you okay, Leone? Let me help you up.

steps.name: Panic-stricken Shop Proprietor
steps.text: *sigh*... Those brats can be so cruel. Your face's all bloody...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I'm okay... Just a little dizzy...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Look at how they smashed the place up... It wasn't just the display windows?

steps.name: Panic-stricken Shop Proprietor
steps.text: Forget the windows... They cleaned out the whole store.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What the hell is going on tonight?

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: We're short on time here, gramps. Quit it with the hide-and-seek.

steps.name: Guileful Gangster
steps.text: You're here, aren't you?!

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: What a pain. This place is so cluttered... No room to move at all...

steps.name: Guileful Gangster
steps.text: Get out here already, you old bastard!

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Mmm...

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: Heh, surprised you could dodge that with your leg. Guess I didn't give you enough credit. Let's see how long your luck's gonna hold out.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Gargh!

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: Heh, got you!

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: Honestly, you're lucky to die in this stinking place. Suits you just perfectly.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: (Just a little more... Hang in there, old bones. It'll work... It'll definitely work.)

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: Now I can finally say goodbye to you, old fart.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Not so fast...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: It's over for you, punks.

steps.name: Guileful Gangster
steps.text: What's this... Steam?!

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: It burns!

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: You're right, though. This stinking place is my home, so of course it's a great fit for me.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Phew... No one makes trouble in my house.

spans.text: Phew... No one makes trouble in

steps.name: Hard-hearted Hoodlum
steps.text: Nngh...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: You asked for this.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You're right. It's not fully loaded, and it took quite a bit of trouble to get these to fire in my gun.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Which is why... I ain't wasting any on you. It's not worth it.
The old man holsters his gun and removes his cufflinks. He then rolls back his sleeves to reveal his arms.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Really, Woody? At your age?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: When's the last time you saw me use my whip?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: When you sold those stockbeasts to the caravan for supplies, outside the plate... So three or four years ago?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Right. Only three or four years ago.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I'll take care of their leaders. Can you take care of the rest?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Sure thing, leave it to me.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Make it quick... There's still time before dawn. Maybe we can catch some beauty sleep.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Too bad there ain't any trees around to hang you from. I could try it from the roof, though...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What's wrong? You got us surrounded, but none of you have the balls to lead the charge?

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Don't get cocky, you old bastard. This show's just getting started.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What's the word on the street? What's going on tonight?

steps.name: Panic-stricken Shop Proprietor
steps.text: These are all the bandages I have left. It's not enough to wrap your head, but... press them against the wound. Helps stop the blood.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I'm fine. Just tell me what you know.

steps.name: Panic-stricken Shop Proprietor
steps.text: At first, I heard some things from the east side of the plate. You know, where all the thugs gather.

steps.name: Panic-stricken Shop Proprietor
steps.text: They say lots of folks in town think that, since we ain't ever gonna pay the banks back... they might as well...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Might as well what?

steps.name: Panic-stricken Shop Proprietor
steps.text: ...Might as well rob everyone... then flee to the frontier for a fresh start.

steps.name: Panic-stricken Shop Proprietor
steps.text: You saw it. It's like they all went crazy. They're beating people up, smashing up stores, stealing everything...

steps.name: Panic-stricken Shop Proprietor
steps.text: Wait, Leone... Look. That's... the direction of your home...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Dammit!

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Manager, I... I heard the situation outside is pretty bad.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Calm down, Sylvia. We're all safe here inside the bank.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: They're a despicable bunch beyond redemption, but before us and only us, they're perfect gentlemen.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: If you're afraid, get some sleep. By the time you wake up, you'll never see them again.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Has no one told you? Our business partners will be here soon. Before you know it, those men will be useless to us.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Which is why when they suggested they'd leave town with some... souvenirs, we had no reason not to go along with it.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: All we have to do is wait patiently, like we've done so many times. Hold tight, and everything will be as it should be—

steps.name: Bank Employee
steps.text: Manager, I just got a transmission from Blacksteel! Their landship is arriving sooner than expected!

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Tsk, not only are they here, they're here sooner than we thought...

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: But it's all the same to us.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Looks like you didn't learn your lesson.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Shit... Every damn time, it's either a lesson or a warning. You ever going to fight for real?!

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: My hand!

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: If you're that eager to eat a bullet, I could oblige.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Left foot, or left hand? Pick one.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: You have no idea... You can chase us off today... but there's more where we came from...

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Not one of you is ever gonna get away...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I'd worry about myself first, if I were you.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What's that noise—?

steps.name: Helpless Plate Resident
steps.text: Fire! Help—!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ma'am, is Leone still inside?!

steps.name: Helpless Plate Resident
steps.text: I-I don't know. When I came out, the house was already on fire!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Please make way, ma'am!

steps.name: Helpless Plate Resident
steps.text: What are you doing, girl?! You can't go inside. The fire's too strong! You won't make it back out!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ma'am, please go find more people to help fight the fire. I'll go inside to look for Leone.

steps.name: Helpless Plate Resident
steps.text: Who is he to you anyway? Why put your life on the line to save him?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: An acquaintance. Now please, let me go!

steps.name: Helpless Plate Resident
steps.text: That's it? Not even a friend? Don't do this! Ah—
Jessica, why are you here? Wh-What are you doing?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Leone?!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: So you weren't inside...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I saw it, Jessica. I saw it.

steps.name: Helpless Plate Resident
steps.text: Leone, she said she was gonna run into the fire looking for you...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I-I thought you—

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Don't cry, my girl. I'm doing just fine.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: B-But your house...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: It doesn't matter... It's okay... I can sleep over at Helena's.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Good thing no one else lives here. I had nothing but empty walls to look at anyway. It was suffocating... It's not so bad it got burned down.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Now... There's nothing to dwell on anymore.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What's that noise?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What do I do...? What do I do...?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What do you do? I told you. It's burned down. Let it stay that way.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What do I do... what do I do... what do I do...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No, what do you mean, 'what do I do?' What's wrong?

steps.name: Blacksteel Senior Operator
steps.text: Tila, I see you going in and out of Mr. Cliff's office. Did Liskarm's squad screw this up?

steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: No, there's an emergency situation on the plate, but they've completed their mission. The landship will connect to Davistown very soon.

steps.name: Blacksteel Senior Operator
steps.text: Got it. All those debtors will know better than to hang around once we're there, so—

steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: Watch what you say.

steps.name: Blacksteel Senior Operator
steps.text: Sorry, my bad.

steps.name: Blacksteel Senior Operator
steps.text: But what did the boss say about it? Don't tell me he had a change of heart just because people are making trouble?

steps.name: Blacksteel Intelligence Squad Member
steps.text: Everyone is to proceed according to plan.

steps.name: Blacksteel Senior Operator
steps.text: Alright—

steps.name: Blacksteel Senior Operator
steps.text: ...At last, looks like we're almost there.
First, there was a strange gust causing everyone's hair to flutter.
Next, there was the rumble they felt beneath their feet.
Finally, there was a loud boom in the sky, hundreds of yards away.
Breaking through the dense fog of the winter night, Fort Barron has finally arrived after its two week journey.
Everyone is gathered on the streets or standing by the windows, watching it intently.
Whether they welcome it or reject it, it arrives.
Whether this has been a nightmare or a pleasant dream, they are all jolted awake.
Woodrow weighs the gun in his hand. He's not very pleased at being interrupted.
He looks away from the vessel in the distance to find that the man on the ground has scurried away, leaving only a long, bloody trail.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Heh... Should've shot his foot when I had the chance.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Goddammit.
